question:

{%- call statement('all', fetch_result=True) -%}

select * from {{ source("energy_sellers", "energy") }}

{%- endcall -%}

{%- set all = load_result('all') -%}

title: Getting result from select query with dbt jinja
answer:
The line number from the error message is coming from after the DBT compiles and runs your model. You can see the results under target/run/<project_name>/models/example/energey_sellers.sql

What you will find when you open that model is basically something like this

 create or replace   view <DB>.<SCHEMA>.energy_sellers
  
   as (
    
  );

The reason you're getting the error is because your model isn't outputting anything. All your model is doing is executing a query at compile time and then storing the results in a variable called all. There is no SQL being produced, which results in DBT generating the empty create statement above.

When you remove the call statement, your compiled version of the model will be

 create or replace   view <DB>.<SCHEMA>.energy_sellers
  
   as (
    select * from <DB>.energy_sellers.energy
  );

which is why that version works. If you want to see the results, you can add {% do log(all['data']) %}. This will output the results to your console, but the model will still fail until you actually produce valid SQL.
